_comment: MEDIA-02 review registry. One key per workflow id, listing every fingerprint a human has actually reviewed and the executable node types (class_type) that fingerprint's graph uses. src/media_workflows.review_status() compares a loaded template against this file: an exact fingerprint match is approved outright, and a changed template is still approved as long as it introduces no class_type outside the union already reviewed for that id. A template that introduces a genuinely new executable node is refused (reason 'needs_review') by src/media_runs.plan()/start() until a reviewer adds an entry here — which is itself a code-reviewed change to this file, the same authority config/media_workflows/*.json already has. Regenerate an id's node_types by loading the template and calling media_workflows.graph_node_types(workflow); do not hand-edit the fingerprint.
